Policy ID: POL-001
Policy Name: Leave Policy

Purpose:
This document defines the organization's leave policy.

Policy Rules:
Employees receive 20 days of paid leave annually. Leave requests must be submitted to the manager at least 3 working days in advance.

Exceptions:
Emergency leave can be approved by the HR manager.

Responsibility:
The relevant department is responsible for implementing
and monitoring this policy.

Review:
This policy must be reviewed annually.

Policy ID: POL-002
Policy Name: Work From Home Policy

Purpose:
This document defines the organization's work from home policy.

Policy Rules:
Employees can work from home up to 2 days per week. Requests must be approved by the reporting manager.

Exceptions:
Employees handling restricted office equipment must work from the office.

Responsibility:
The relevant department is responsible for implementing
and monitoring this policy.

Review:
This policy must be reviewed annually.

Policy ID: POL-003
Policy Name: Data Security Policy

Purpose:
This document defines the organization's data security policy.

Policy Rules:
Employees must use strong passwords with at least 12 characters. Passwords must be changed every 90 days.

Exceptions:
Security administrators can enforce immediate password resets.

Responsibility:
The relevant department is responsible for implementing
and monitoring this policy.

Review:
This policy must be reviewed annually.

Policy ID: POL-004
Policy Name: Password Policy

Purpose:
This document defines the organization's password policy.

Policy Rules:
Passwords must contain uppercase letters, lowercase letters, numbers and special characters. Password sharing is prohibited.

Exceptions:
Temporary passwords must be changed at first login.

Responsibility:
The relevant department is responsible for implementing
and monitoring this policy.

Review:
This policy must be reviewed annually.

Policy ID: POL-005
Policy Name: Employee Attendance Policy

Purpose:
This document defines the organization's employee attendance policy.

Policy Rules:
Employees must complete 8 working hours daily. Attendance must be recorded using the official attendance system.

Exceptions:
Approved business travel is exempt from office check-in.

Responsibility:
The relevant department is responsible for implementing
and monitoring this policy.

Review:
This policy must be reviewed annually.

Policy ID: POL-006
Policy Name: Remote Access Policy

Purpose:
This document defines the organization's remote access policy.

Policy Rules:
Remote access is permitted only through the company VPN. Multi-factor authentication is mandatory.

Exceptions:
IT administrators may temporarily disable access during security incidents.

Responsibility:
The relevant department is responsible for implementing
and monitoring this policy.

Review:
This policy must be reviewed annually.

Policy ID: POL-007
Policy Name: Email Usage Policy

Purpose:
This document defines the organization's email usage policy.

Policy Rules:
Company email accounts must be used for official communication. Employees must not share confidential information through personal email.

Exceptions:
HR-approved external communication is permitted.

Responsibility:
The relevant department is responsible for implementing
and monitoring this policy.

Review:
This policy must be reviewed annually.

Policy ID: POL-008
Policy Name: Device Usage Policy

Purpose:
This document defines the organization's device usage policy.

Policy Rules:
Company laptops must use approved antivirus software and automatic screen locking. Employees must not install unauthorized applications.

Exceptions:
IT support can approve software installations.

Responsibility:
The relevant department is responsible for implementing
and monitoring this policy.

Review:
This policy must be reviewed annually.

Policy ID: POL-009
Policy Name: Incident Reporting Policy

Purpose:
This document defines the organization's incident reporting policy.

Policy Rules:
Employees must report security incidents to the IT security team within 30 minutes of discovery.

Exceptions:
Critical incidents must be escalated immediately to the security manager.

Responsibility:
The relevant department is responsible for implementing
and monitoring this policy.

Review:
This policy must be reviewed annually.

Policy ID: POL-010
Policy Name: Data Retention Policy

Purpose:
This document defines the organization's data retention policy.

Policy Rules:
Customer transaction records must be retained for 7 years. Access to archived records requires authorization.

Exceptions:
Legal holds can extend the retention period.

Responsibility:
The relevant department is responsible for implementing
and monitoring this policy.

Review:
This policy must be reviewed annually.

Policy ID: POL-011
Policy Name: Customer Privacy Policy

Purpose:
This document defines the organization's customer privacy policy.

Policy Rules:
Customer personal information must only be accessed for legitimate business purposes. Unauthorized disclosure is prohibited.

Exceptions:
Disclosure required by law must be approved by the legal team.

Responsibility:
The relevant department is responsible for implementing
and monitoring this policy.

Review:
This policy must be reviewed annually.

Policy ID: POL-012
Policy Name: Access Control Policy

Purpose:
This document defines the organization's access control policy.

Policy Rules:
Employees receive access based on their job responsibilities. Managers must review access permissions every 6 months.

Exceptions:
Emergency access requires security team approval.

Responsibility:
The relevant department is responsible for implementing
and monitoring this policy.

Review:
This policy must be reviewed annually.

Policy ID: POL-013
Policy Name: Backup Policy

Purpose:
This document defines the organization's backup policy.

Policy Rules:
Critical business databases must be backed up daily. Backup copies must be stored in a separate secure location.

Exceptions:
IT administrators must verify backup restoration every quarter.

Responsibility:
The relevant department is responsible for implementing
and monitoring this policy.

Review:
This policy must be reviewed annually.

Policy ID: POL-014
Policy Name: Business Continuity Policy

Purpose:
This document defines the organization's business continuity policy.

Policy Rules:
Critical business applications must be restored within 4 hours of a major outage. The disaster recovery plan must be tested annually.

Exceptions:
The business continuity manager can declare a disaster.

Responsibility:
The relevant department is responsible for implementing
and monitoring this policy.

Review:
This policy must be reviewed annually.

Policy ID: POL-015
Policy Name: Software Development Policy

Purpose:
This document defines the organization's software development policy.

Policy Rules:
All production code changes require peer review and automated testing. Direct changes to production systems are prohibited.

Exceptions:
Emergency fixes require approval from the engineering manager.

Responsibility:
The relevant department is responsible for implementing
and monitoring this policy.

Review:
This policy must be reviewed annually.

Policy ID: POL-016
Policy Name: Vendor Management Policy

Purpose:
This document defines the organization's vendor management policy.

Policy Rules:
All vendors must pass security assessment before accessing company systems. Vendor agreements must define data protection responsibilities.

Exceptions:
High-risk vendors require additional security reviews.

Responsibility:
The relevant department is responsible for implementing
and monitoring this policy.

Review:
This policy must be reviewed annually.

Policy ID: POL-017
Policy Name: Expense Reimbursement Policy

Purpose:
This document defines the organization's expense reimbursement policy.

Policy Rules:
Employees can claim approved business travel expenses within 30 days. Receipts are required for expenses above 500 rupees.

Exceptions:
Exceptions require finance department approval.

Responsibility:
The relevant department is responsible for implementing
and monitoring this policy.

Review:
This policy must be reviewed annually.

Policy ID: POL-018
Policy Name: Training Policy

Purpose:
This document defines the organization's training policy.

Policy Rules:
Employees must complete mandatory security awareness training every year. Training completion is tracked by HR.

Exceptions:
New employees must complete training within 30 days of joining.

Responsibility:
The relevant department is responsible for implementing
and monitoring this policy.

Review:
This policy must be reviewed annually.

Policy ID: POL-019
Policy Name: Mobile Device Policy

Purpose:
This document defines the organization's mobile device policy.

Policy Rules:
Employees accessing company data on mobile devices must enable device encryption and screen locking.

Exceptions:
Lost or stolen devices must be reported to IT within 1 hour.

Responsibility:
The relevant department is responsible for implementing
and monitoring this policy.

Review:
This policy must be reviewed annually.

Policy ID: POL-020
Policy Name: Employee Exit Policy

Purpose:
This document defines the organization's employee exit policy.

Policy Rules:
Employees leaving the company must return company assets on their last working day. IT must revoke system access within 24 hours of departure.

Exceptions:
HR can request immediate access revocation.

Responsibility:
The relevant department is responsible for implementing
and monitoring this policy.

Review:
This policy must be reviewed annually.
